title: Portable query AST and dialect compilers
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only; higher evidence levels require the named open gates. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

open_gates: Expand proximity, wildcard, controlled-vocabulary, subheading and line-set conformance against independently reviewed strategies.
assertions.permitted_claim: A portable query model and source-aware compiler are implemented for declared subsets; complete database semantics are not claimed.

open_gates: Compile and execute native strategy unit tests.
assertions.permitted_claim: Line-numbered native strategy source, spans, diagnostics and raw-source preservation are source implemented; semantic parsing remains deliberately partial.

assertions.statement: Build PubMed/Ovid MEDLINE/Embase/CINAHL/PsycINFO/Scopus/Web of Science corpus
open_gates: Replace or supplement synthetic examples with rights-cleared, independently PRESS-reviewed strategies.
assertions.permitted_claim: A seven-dialect source-preservation corpus exists and is statically validated; it is not an external conformance benchmark.

assertions.statement: Add named filter contracts with source/version/citation
open_gates: Define versioned named-filter records with source citation, checksum, applicability and expiry.
assertions.permitted_claim: Filter names and rationales can be recorded; validated named-filter packs are not yet implemented.

assertions.statement: Add syntax parsers for supported native dialect subsets
open_gates: Implement dialect-specific lexical and syntactic parsers with structured unsupported-node diagnostics.
assertions.permitted_claim: A lossless line-oriented native parser exists; database-specific syntax parsers are not claimed.

assertions.statement: Create metamorphic and round-trip translation tests
open_gates: Implement and compile metamorphic and round-trip tests for the supported syntax subsets.
assertions.permitted_claim: The corpus and compiler provide inputs for round-trip testing; metamorphic equivalence is not yet proven.
